changelog:
Initial public release of “spaced-repetition” skill.

- Added detailed documentation on mechanisms of spaced repetition, including retrieval practice, forgetting curve, and card design.
- Updated SKILL.md with practical tips on review schedules, card creation, review economy, and algorithm differences (SM-2 vs FSRS).
- Introduced metadata in SKILL.md; added new _meta.json file for structured data.
- Removed skill-card.md to streamline documentation.
- Included best practices for sustainable long-term retention and spaced review.
summary: Scheduling review of material at expanding intervals to optimize long-term retention.
